introHtml: SS refers to one-size-fits-most personal protection items like bandanas, face coverings, and sanitizer packets. Choose from cotton bandanas for breathable comfort or antimicrobial lanyards for daily wear. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery to keep your logo visible on the job site.
